top_choice_rationale: P001 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp) pairs a joint theoretical origin, the Z2 classification and quantum spin Hall proposal, with a decisive HgTe edge-transport observation, and fifteen-plus years of independent confirmation by transport, ARPES and scanning probes make it mature. Band topology has reorganised how matter is classified well beyond solids, and the allocation follows the prediction-to-observation chain without splitting Kane and Mele. The omission of Bernevig, Hughes, Zhang, Fu, Moore, Balents, Roy and Hasan is a real cost of the three-name limit, but the citation can be scoped to the quantum spin Hall state and Z2 classification. P002 (Katori, Ye) is a sound, cleanly attributed second choice and a narrower achievement. Awarding nothing is the least defensible outcome given two mature candidates.
